description: For every formula \(A\), its actual Tseitin clause list has at most \(3N(A)+1\) clauses and \(7N(A)+1\) literal occurrences, and every clause has length at most three.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.encoding_bounds.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.encoding A).length ≤
      3 * Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.treeSize A + 1 ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.literalCount
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.encoding A) ≤
        7 * Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.treeSize A + 1 ∧
      ∀ C ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.encoding A, C.length ≤ 3
